tools.name: foxy_get_api_home
tools.description: Get the Foxy hAPI home document — its _links / rels (including fx:store for the authenticated default store). Useful for HAL discovery. Foxy hAPI: GET /.

tools.name: foxy_get_default_store
tools.description: Resolve and return the authenticated user's default store (and its id) by fetching the API home and following the fx:store link. Use this to discover the store_id the list tools accept. Foxy hAPI: GET / then GET fx:store.

tools.name: foxy_get_store
tools.description: Get a single store resource by id, including its settings and _links to sub-collections. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_transactions
tools.description: List a store's transactions (orders), newest first. Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:transactions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/transactions.

tools.name: foxy_get_transaction
tools.description: Get a single transaction by id, optionally zooming related resources (items, customer, payments, applied_taxes…). Foxy hAPI: GET /transactions/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List a store's subscriptions (recurring orders). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:subscriptions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/subscriptions.

tools.name: foxy_get_subscription
tools.description: Get a single subscription by id, optionally zooming related resources. Foxy hAPI: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_customers
tools.description: List a store's customers. Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:customers. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/customers.

tools.name: foxy_get_customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id, optionally zooming related resources (default_billing_address, subscriptions…). Foxy hAPI: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_carts
tools.description: List a store's carts (in-progress / abandoned checkouts). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:carts. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/carts.

tools.name: foxy_list_coupons
tools.description: List a store's coupons (discount codes and their rules). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:coupons. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/coupons.

tools.name: foxy_list_items
tools.description: List the line items of a transaction (the products purchased). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:items. Foxy hAPI: GET /transactions/{transaction_id}/items.

tools.name: foxy_update_customer
tools.description: UPDATES a customer's profile fields (first_name, last_name, email). This MODIFIES live store data. Foxy hAPI: PATCH /customers/{id}. Provide only the fields you want to change.

tools.name: foxy_update_subscription
tools.description: UPDATES a subscription — reschedule its next run (next_transaction_date), change its frequency, or activate/pause it (is_active). This MODIFIES live store data and affects future billing. Foxy hAPI: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}. Provide only the fields you want to change.
